description: Hasbro, Inc. is a leading game, intellectual property and toy company whose mission is to create joy and community through the magic of play, and with over 100 years of expertise it delivers play experiences to kids, families and fans around the world through physical and digital games, video games, toys, licensed consumer products, location-based entertainment, film and TV. Through its franchise-first approach it unlocks value from both new and legacy intellectual property, including MAGIC: THE GATHERING, MONOPOLY, Hasbro Games, PLAY-DOH, TRANSFORMERS, DUNGEONS & DRAGONS, NERF and PEPPA PIG, as well as premier partner brands, and powered by a portfolio of iconic brands and a diversified network of partners and subsidiary studios it brings fans together wherever they are, from tabletop to screen.
